title: Sword Boosted V2
description: The best sword pack that modifies your armor and your tools.
body:
**This resource pack was created with the goal of improving Sword gameplay.**

**This pack modifies several things, such as:**

**- Blocks**

**- Particles**

**- Diamond armors and tools**

![Modifications](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c97d17c1655a6f1fe83e1f26cff20c4ce106033.webp)

**Here is a list of servers where you can practice:**

**- eu.swiftpvp.xyz**

**- ukffa.xyz**

**- eu.stray.gg**

**- vexaay.nl**

**Join this server discord :**

**- https://dc.gg/pvptrain**

**This resource pack is compatible with many other resource packs.**
